description: Reads a web page and returns its main text as Markdown (headings, paragraphs, lists,
tables, code), without menus, ads or scripts; plain text and JSON come back as they are.
Give a full http:// or https:// address. A long page comes back in parts: its last line
says where it stopped, and start= reads on from there. Pages that are not text (images,
PDFs, archives) are refused. For a front page or an index (news, a blog, search results),
use mode=links: its headlines as links, which you can then read one by one.

params.name: start
params.description: Where in the text to begin, from the end line of the previous part; omit it for the start

params.name: mode
params.description: text (default): the page's main text; links: its links with their text, the headlines of a front page or an index

params.name: links
params.description: Keep the page's links as Markdown links (default false)
